messages:
maria.g: quick q — mapping retention tiers for security logs. who decides which events go to long-term (7y) vs 90d? also need guidance on KMS delegation for oncall pulls. do we have a safelist for SIEM exports so SRE can pull during incidents without full key unwrap? @alex.k @samir

alex.k: short — decision lives in sec-retention-policy doc but it's coarse. we should add a tag->bucket mapping. +1 for timeboxed safelist for incident unwraps. current approach: CMK wrapping + proxy service for unwraps, no direct user decrypt.

samir: we use a `forensics` tag in a few places that maps to long-term. propose: `forensics`->7y, `auth`->1y, `telemetry`->90d. prod owners opt-in to `forensics`. prefer proxy: only proxy has `kms:Decrypt`. users assume short-lived role to call proxy.

jess: compliance will require written justification for any 7y retention and an auditable trail for unwraps (who, why, TTL). add retention justification into tenant onboarding checklist.

maria.g: can someone sketch minimal IAM/flow for timeboxed unwraps? ideally no permanent `kms:Decrypt` on user accounts.

alex.k: runbook sketch:

1) Oncall files incident ticket with ID and justification
2) Sec-oncall approves in Slack (emoji + link) — approval recorded
3) Ops issues STS token to assume temp role `kms-unwrapper` (1h)
4) Temp role calls proxy endpoint
5) Proxy performs KMS Decrypt with CMK and logs request to audit bucket
6) Unwrap metadata stored at `audit/unwraps/<incident-id>.json`

samir: add OPA eval before STS issuance to check scope and TTL. proxy returns data blobs, not keys. rotate CMK and include key version in audit.

devsecops-bot: PR gate: retention-buckets.tf modified in PR #1245 — security review requested from @security.

oncall: manual process is slow in incidents. can we have an "urgent unwrap" path that still enforces human approval but uses an automated fast path? need a short checklist.

jess: automation ok but require human approval. generated justification doc (who, why, approval) must be auto-uploaded to `audit/unwraps/` and linked in ticket.

alex.k: also recommend safelist on SIEM export side: consumer apps get expiring tokens scoped to read-only scrubbed exports instead of unwrap perms. prefer tokenized export pipeline rather than granting unwrap permissions.

maria.g: action items: alex -> draft mapping table + runbook; samir -> propose KMS proxy role + OPA policy; jess -> compliance checklist + onboarding addition; devsecops-bot -> block PR until review. i'll open follow-up thread with draft. :thumbsup:
